summary: Chinese PP offers trend up post-holiday; Petrochina L5E89/T30S +USD 40 to 1,440 CFR
Domestic plants lifted today: NSRP 114G to VND 40,000 (Kanetorra); BSR T3034 pushed to 41,000
Lotte PP homo 1,360 CIF (+50); S-Oil copo 36/37MK10 still VND 39,000 early week
paras: Import offers for Chinese-origin PP continue to trend steadily higher since China returned from the early-October holiday on October 8. Today, October 15, one Jinneng distributor offered Jinneng PP yarn/injection/BOPP to Vietnam sharply higher, up USD 45/tonne from the start of the week, at USD 1,410-1,420/tonne/FOB Qingdao, and PP copolymer injection EP300H at USD 1,440/tonne/FOB… These offers are up USD 50/tonne from last week and up sharply by as much as USD 120/tonne from late September. The CIF price to Vietnam typically adds about USD 30-50/tonne over the FOB offers above.
Similarly, Petrochina's distributor today quoted PP yarn L5E89 and T30S at USD 1,440/tonne/CFR Vietnam, up sharply by as much as USD 40/tonne from the CIF Hai Phong offer early this week.

Currently, offers for Chinese-origin PP are at higher levels than for Korean material. This week, the distributors of UPP and H&L Advanced (a joint venture between Lotte and HD Hyundai) of South Korea both offered PP homo to Vietnam at USD 1,400/tonne/CIF; UPP's PP BOPP at USD 1,420/tonne/CIF; and UPP's PP block copolymer ranged USD 1,450-1,480/tonne/CIF depending on grade.

Likewise, the distributor of South Korea's Lotte Chemical offered PP homo grades to Vietnam at USD 1,360/tonne/CIF — up USD 50/tonne from last month but in very small volume; PP Film at USD 1,380/tonne/CIF — up USD 30/tonne; and PP block copolymer at USD 1,400/tonne/CIF…

Domestically, after fairly timid adjustments over the first three days of the week, today offers for PP from domestic plants and distributors were adjusted up more clearly, though still well below new import offers.

Accordingly, in the north, a leading NSRP distributor, Kanetorra, raised its PP 114G offer to VND 40,000/kg including VAT, while another major distributor, Marubeni, has not yet announced new prices. In the northern trading market, most sellers also pushed up offers for domestically sourced PP yarn/injection such as NSRP and BSR and for Korean- and Chinese-origin PP… to VND 40,200-40,500/kg including VAT. Chinese-origin PP copolymer grades such as K8003/K8009 were offered at VND 40,500-41,000/kg including VAT.

In the south, offers for BSR's PP yarn T3034 were pushed sharply higher by distributors to VND 41,000/kg including VAT, higher than quotations in the north. Some Chinese-origin PP yarn/injection grades were also offered up to VND 40,700-41,200/kg including VAT depending on grade and seller.

Earlier this week, the Hyosung Vina plant offered PP injection J700N sharply higher at VND 39,600/kg excluding VAT (about VND 42,770/kg with the full 8% VAT), and PP random R801N at VND 41,200/kg excluding VAT (about VND 44,500/kg with the full 8% VAT)…

Notably, early this week some northern traders were still offering S-Oil (South Korea) PP copolymer 36MK10 and 37MK10 at VND 39,000/kg including VAT — up VND 500/kg from the previous week (up VND 1,000-1,500/kg from early October). However, today one distributor, Chemdo, quoted PP copolymer 36MK10 at VND 42,800/kg including VAT in the north and VND 43,300/kg including VAT in the south, both inclusive of freight, for cargoes delivering in the last week of October to early November. This distributor's offer is considered high relative to buyers' ability to accept.

summary: Platts: NE Asia HDPE rose sharply; PE up across the board led by China post-holiday
Petrochina LLDPE Film +USD 50 to 1,450-1,460 CIF Hai Phong; US-origin PE plentiful (Vinmar/Exxon)
Sabic 218WJ / Qamar FD21HS offered to ~VND 44,000; November LLDPE also rising; HDPE trending down
paras: According to Platts assessments released today, October 15, in Northeast Asia the general price level for HDPE Film/yarn/injection/blow rose sharply by USD 40/tonne this week from last week, LLDPE rose USD 45/tonne and LDPE rose USD 50/tonne. In Southeast Asia, HDPE Film/yarn/injection/blow all rose USD 20/tonne to USD 1,290-1,300/tonne/CFR, LLDPE rose USD 20/tonne to USD 1,240/tonne/CFR, metallocene C6 LLDPE rose USD 20/tonne to USD 1,390/tonne/CFR, and LDPE rose USD 20/tonne to USD 1,610/tonne/CFR.

Thus, PE prices in Asia rose across the board during the week, led by the increase in the Chinese market after the holiday. In Southeast Asia and Vietnam, the increase was more modest amid subdued trading activity. Prices rose on higher crude oil and naphtha costs, while supply in some regions, especially LDPE, is scarce…

In Vietnam, today Petrochina China's distributor quoted LLDPE Film offers up USD 50/tonne from the CIF Hai Phong offer early this week, to USD 1,450-1,460/tonne/CFR. Lotte Titan Malaysia announced settled prices for some grades USD 20/tonne lower than the early-week offers (and USD 30/tonne higher than last month's settled prices). Specifically, settled prices for LDPE Film/Shrink film were USD 1,580-1,600/tonne/CIF, and settled prices for LDPE coating 800YY and LLDPE injection 300YY were both USD 1,680/tonne/CIF.

PE offers of US origin to Vietnam are currently fairly plentiful, including material from the US and cargoes shipped from some countries neighboring Vietnam. Specifically, one distributor offered US Chevron HDPE Film to Vietnam at USD 1,310/tonne/CIF, shipped from Malaysia in November.

Distributor NCT offered several PE cargoes from the US to Vietnam. These included Vinmar HDPE injection HD8065U at USD 1,220/tonne/CFR, and Exxon Mobil LLDPE Film 1018W (with additives) and 2018B (without additives) at USD 1,230-1,240/tonne/CFR. These cargoes carry a certificate of origin (COO), with NCT-branded packaging. Likewise, offers for Ciplas — Itochu LLDPE Film (MI 1) were at USD 1,295/tonne/CIF, LSD December 15, 2026, up sharply by USD 70/tonne from last week.

Midweek, PTT of Thailand's distributor adjusted its LLDPE injection and HDPE Film/yarn offers to Vietnam up slightly by USD 10/tonne (after cutting USD 30/tonne last week), to USD 1,430/tonne/CIF HCMC, with no LDPE offered. Formosa Taiwan's distributor offered HDPE yarn to Vietnam at USD 1,380/tonne/CIF, and LLDPE injection at USD 1,430-1,440/tonne/CIF.

Saudi Arabia's Basell offered LDPE Film 2427K/2427H to Vietnam at USD 1,530/tonne/CIF HCMC, ETD November 2026, shipped from Saudi Arabia. Another major Middle Eastern producer, Equate Kuwait, offered LLDPE Film 7087 (MI 1) at USD 1,385/tonne/CIF Hai Phong, HCMC (inclusive of CIC), with payment terms of 20% in advance and expected delivery on November 15, 2026…

As previously analyzed, imported PE offers are very plentiful and diverse. However, logistics remains a major bottleneck, with Middle Eastern and US cargoes typically delivered slowly after about 2 months and on uncertain schedules. Most buyers are waiting for prompt-delivery cargoes from China, but imported cargoes from China are also being repeatedly notified of delays… leaving spot PE supply in the domestic market still fairly limited, especially for LDPE and LLDPE.

Domestically, today some traders raised LDPE offers again (after easing last week and holding flat since the start of this week). Accordingly, in the north, Lotte Titan's LDPE Film 260GG was offered up to VND 46,500-47,000/kg including VAT depending on volume and seller; PTT Thailand's LDPE 2426K/2426H was offered sharply up to VND 48,000-48,500/kg including VAT because very few traders have inventory left (while the PTT plant has no October-November 2026 cargoes offered to Vietnam); Korean- and Middle Eastern-origin LDPE Film grades held flat or edged up, commonly at VND 45,000-46,000/kg including VAT…

For LLDPE, after the fairly strong price increase early this week, by midweek offers from distributors were trending flat or edging up on some scarce grades. Offer gaps between distributors are fairly large. Currently, Middle Eastern-origin LLDPE Film offers are holding at high levels of up to VND 43,500-44,500/kg including VAT. Chinese-origin LLDPE Film offers are at VND 41,500-42,000/kg including VAT…
“Popular grades such as Sabic's LLDPE 218WJ and Qamar's FD21HS… have all been offered up to around VND 44,000/kg including VAT,” a northern source said.

Not only spot material but also far-forward November-delivery LLDPE is rising. One distributor offered Sabic LLDPE Film grades such as 118WJ, 222WJ, 222NJ and 218BJ… for November delivery at VND 40,500-42,500/kg including VAT depending on grade, at Hai Phong or HCMC port; grade 218WJ alone was offered as high as VND 44,300-44,400/kg including VAT; Qamar LLDPE Film FD21HN and FD21HS at VND 42,500-42,700/kg including VAT at port; and Baofeng and CNPC (China)-origin LLDPE Film 7042/7047/7050 at VND 41,200-41,700/kg including VAT, with coal-based material from Ningmei offered at VND 39,600/kg including VAT…

HDPE has a downward price trend. Today, LSP's office offered CP Chem Singapore HDPE blow 5502S at VND 43,200/kg including VAT, down slightly by VND 200/kg from last week, with retail settlement for some customers at VND 42,600-42,800/kg including VAT. This price level is higher than for Chinese and US HDPE blow — currently offered at VND 39,700-40,000/kg including VAT — or Saudi Arabia's HDPE blow 5502BN, offered at VND 41,300-41,500/kg including VAT. For HDPE Film, offers also ranged VND 39,500-42,000/kg including VAT, down from last week.

summary: Platts: China PVC stable at USD 855 CFR; oil-based FOB China +USD 5 to 755
SCG offered Nov-delivery PVC (one of the earliest in region); buyers await November offers
Domestic SCG SG660/SP660 & local plants stable VND 23,700-24,200; coal SG-5 (Yihua) 23,100 Yen Vien
paras: According to Platts assessments, the general PVC price level in China this week held stable from last week at USD 855/tonne/CFR; PVC prices in Southeast Asia were also flat at USD 825/tonne/CFR.

In practice, export quotations for oil-based PVC on an FOB China basis this week edged up USD 5/tonne from last week to USD 755/tonne/FOB, while export quotations for China's coal-based PVC held steady at USD 730/tonne/FOB. Because ocean freight rates on routes from China have risen, CIF Vietnam offers may be as much as USD 50/tonne above the FOB prices above.

Market participants said most buyers in Southeast Asia remain on the sidelines awaiting November offer announcements. Downstream demand and expectations that prices will keep falling have limited prompt purchases, leading many buyers to consume existing inventories rather than add supply. This has helped reduce inventories in some regions. Even so, despite scarce supply, efforts to raise prices have met with buyer resistance.

In Vietnam, midweek SCG of Thailand's distributor offered November 2026-delivery PVC, one of the earliest producers in the region to quote November PVC. SG660 was offered at USD 845/tonne/CIF, and SP660 at USD 840/tonne/CIF. PVC offers for November delivery are thus USD 1-4/tonne lower than the September 17 offer levels (October delivery), indicating almost negligible change.

Domestically, SCG SG660 and SP660 and PVC from domestic plants in Vietnam held stable since late last week, commonly at VND 23,700-24,200/kg including VAT. Price levels for oil-based PVC of other origins also commonly ranged VND 23,500-24,500/kg including VAT.

For coal-based PVC, the leading distributor for China's Yihua offered PVC SG-5 at the Yen Vien (Hanoi) warehouse at VND 23,100/kg including VAT, for delivery in 3-4 weeks. This price is down only slightly, by VND 100/kg, from two weeks ago in late September, indicating that coal-based PVC price levels are being maintained fairly stably.
